title: Diff. Sigmoidal MF
text: Difference of two sigmoids membership function, 1 input, 1 output; {Left curve a1} sets the transition area shape parameter for left, {Left curve c1} sets the transition area center for left curve, {Right curve a2} sets the transition area shape parameter for right and {Right curve c2} sets the transition area center for right curve. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Left curve a1
params.values: Transition area shape parameter for left curve 3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Left curve c1
params.values: Transition area center for left curve -5 (default) | scalar

params.name: Right curve a2
params.values: Transition area shape parameter for right curve 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Right curve c2
params.values: Transition area center for right curve 5 (default) | scalar
